activity_summary: You looked at the cue roll in Nick's hands over the cold boards. The two new stops were the only new marks. The speech was not on the page as words.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not add a word.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Held the roll. His face was not in it.

entities.name: the Princess's part
entities.context: Mentioned in A cue roll in a boy's hands

facets.activity: Looked at the cue roll in Nick's hands
